properties.name: Falco peregrinus illustrated total range
properties.derivation: Colored seasonal areas from the licensed reference raster traced without smoothing or hand editing and combined as total range. Global inverse Robinson georeferencing; longitudes unwrapped and split at +/-180. White cartographic boundary gaps retained.
properties.limitations: Derived from an illustrated reference, not source expert GIS data. Approximate historical boundaries and cartographic gaps remain. No seasonality asserted.
